parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['company_name','reps','total_accounts_or_market'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const reps=Array.isArray(body.reps)?body.reps:[];if(reps.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'reps must be a non-empty array'}}];const formattedReps=reps.slice(0,12).map(r=>({name:(r.name||'Rep').trim(),region:r.region||'',strengths:(r.strengths||'').slice(0,200),currentAccounts:parseInt(r.current_accounts)||null,quota:parseFloat(r.quota)||null,yearsExperience:parseInt(r.years_experience)||null}));return[{json:{valid:true,companyName:body.company_name.trim(),productDescription:(body.product_description||'').slice(0,400),totalAccountsOrMarket:(body.total_accounts_or_market||'').slice(0,400),segmentationCriteria:Array.isArray(body.segmentation_criteria)?body.segmentation_criteria:(body.segmentation_criteria||'').split('\n').map(c=>c.trim()).filter(Boolean),reps:formattedReps,repCount:formattedReps.length,planningGoal:(body.planning_goal||'maximize_coverage').slice(0,200),currency:body.currency||'USD',totalQuota:parseFloat(body.total_quota)||null,existingTerritories:(body.existing_territories||'').slice(0,600),knownChallenges:(body.known_challenges||'').slice(0,400),replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You design sales territory plans for B2B companies. Good territory design balances workload across reps, matches rep strengths to opportunity type, avoids coverage gaps and conflicts, and gives each rep a realistic path to quota. You give specific reasoning for each assignment. Always respond in valid JSON only.
